answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a grove tag. The pigment cap is upheld at intake and relic reveals the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 5 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
